title: Socket hangups + KV compaction slowpath causing elevated 5xx/timeouts during customer escalations
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Multiple enterprise customers reported sustained increases in 5xx errors and client-side timeouts during tenant surges. Investigation shows a correlated spike when KV cache compaction jobs overlapped with large batched requests: compaction enters a slowpath that temporarily stalls the accept/dispatch loop causing socket hangups and amplified retries. Impact: host-level user-facing 502/504s, elevated p95/p99 token latency, and amplified retry storms for affected tenants during mid-day traffic windows. Scope: observed in hosted clusters running runtime-2.3.x on G4p/G5 instances across us-west-2 and eu-west-1; affects both streaming and non-streaming text generation endpoints. Reproducibility: can be recreated in staging by triggering KV compaction with heavy prefix-cache invalidation plus a synthetic tenant burst (script included in steps_to_reproduce). This ticket coordinates emergency fix, safe rollback, and customer comms.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Deploy runtime-2.3.x with KV compaction enabled and set compaction_window=300s in staging
2) Run synth_burst.py (tools/synthetic_load/synth_burst.py) with 200 concurrent connections and variable prompt lengths (avg 150 tokens) against a single tenant ID
3) Trigger manual compaction via /admin/kv/compact?force=true while burst is ongoing
4) Observe accept-queue growth, socket resets, and p99 latency > 5s in staging dashboard (dash link below)
proposed_mitigations: Short-term: disable automatic KV compaction on hosted clusters in impacted regions (one-line config flip), and enable per-tenant admission backpressure to shed excess new connections
Medium-term: introduce compaction admission controller that delays compaction when accept-queue depth > threshold, and add async compaction worker with bounded concurrency

Long-term: separate compaction IO from accept/dispatch threads (worker pool), refine circuit-breaker to classify slowpath vs immediate failures, and add early-fail for connections older than T seconds to avoid retry amplification
implementation_notes: Patch will include three changes: 1) runtime: add compaction_controller (non-blocking) + config knobs (compaction_window, accept_queue_threshold); 2) edge-proxy: add socket-liveness probe and early-fail path for stale accepts; 3) SDK: guidance update and minor retry default adjustment to reduce aggressive retries for 502/504 temporarily. A/B rollout will use canary tenants (10%) then escalate to 100% if metrics improve.
testing_plan: Unit tests for compaction_controller and new config parsing
Integration tests with synthetic load harness to validate accept-queue behavior under compaction
Chaos test: introduce artificial compaction stall to ensure edge-proxy early-fail path triggers and client gets consistent error code
Staging soak: 48h with production traffic replay and telemetry validation (error-rate, p95, accept-queue-depth)
rollout_plan: 1) Patch runtime and proxy, deploy to staging and run full testing_plan (48h). 2) Canary deploy to 2 clusters (10% traffic) with monitoring alarms (p99 latency, 5xx rate, accept-queue-depth). 3) If canary passes for 2 hours with >80% reduction in 5xx, gradually promote to remaining clusters. 4) If regressions observed, automatic rollback and re-enable previous compaction settings.
communication_plan: Notify affected customers via account SRE + CSM channels with interim mitigation note, provide ETA for fix (target by 2026-03-18) and offer temporary quota/priority routing where contractually required. Post-fix: share root cause summary and timeline, and provide customers with configuration knobs and SDK guidance to avoid noisy retries.
acceptance_criteria: Deployed patch in runtime-2.4.0 to hosted clusters in impacted regions
5xx rate for previously impacted tenants reduced to baseline within 2x of pre-incident level
No increase in error-class elsewhere (no regression on unrelated endpoints),
Runbook updated and a postmortem published in Confluence
postmortem_tasks: Author full incident postmortem and RCA (Confluence)
Update runbooks: add compaction pre-check and rapid-disable instruction
Introduce dashboard tile for accept-queue-depth and compaction overlap events
SDK documentation: adjust retry guidance for intermediate 5xx responses
Backfill e2e tests into CI to detect compaction-induced accept stalls
